record.summary: The three westernmost parcels of Mission Bay Commons (P12, P13 and P15) host interim uses – Spark Social SF, Stagecoach Greens mini golf, Urban Sprouts community garden and soccer fields – which Rec and Park says were 'initially launched as interim uses'; a project fully funded through OCII will renovate them into a permanent park, with construction beginning late 2028 and opening early 2030 on Rec and Park's estimated schedule (expected dates; the same page says the remaining parks are anticipated to be complete by 2028, and OCII's November 2024 timeline shows construction from mid-2027 through 2028).

notes.accuracy_caveat: MEDIUM CONFIDENCE -- real, community-surveyed OSM polygon for the current interim installation (Parklab Gardens; the wider parcel also hosts Spark Social SF, Stagecoach Greens mini golf, Urban Sprouts community garden and an SFF soccer field per SF Rec & Park's own Future Parks Project page). Marked 'existing' rather than 'complete' because this is explicitly an interim use, not the plan's final build-out: the Mission Bay Future Parks Project is planned to redesign parcels P12/P13/P15 into a permanent park (all dates are expected dates and they differ by source: SF Rec & Park's estimated schedule gives planning 2024-2025, design mid 2026, construction begins late 2028 and open to the public early 2030; the same page also says the remaining parks 'are anticipated to be complete by 2028'; OCII's November 2024 update shows a transfer to Rec and Park 'end of 2028, upon completion'; and Rec and Park's Workshop 3 deck shows construction 'mid-2027 thru 2028'). This feature traces OSM way 446183018 (leisure=park, name 'Parklab', about 14,665 sq m and roughly 420 m long), the whole Parklab park strip: it fully contains the separately mapped Parklab Gardens way (437595662, about 2,212 sq m) and the Spark Social SF way (437591532, about 1,519 sq m), so it is not only the Parklab Gardens sub-area.

open_questions: The schedule differs between sources and is not resolved: Rec and Park's project page gives "Construction begins, Late 2028" and "Open to the Public, Early 2030" but also says the remaining parks "are anticipated to be complete by 2028", and slide 9 of OCII's November 14, 2024 update reads "Construction (mid-2027 thru 2028)" and "Transfer to SF Rec Park and Park (end of 2028, upon completion)". All of these are expected dates.

Which interim use started in which year is not stated: OCII's November 2024 timeline gives start years by parcel (P13 2016, P15 2017, P12 2018) but names no uses, and the only use-specific date is Spark Social's May 2016 launch, from a page that does not say which parcel it is on. Beyond those parcel-level pilot start years, no opening dates were found for the soccer fields, community garden, Stagecoach Greens or Parklab Gardens.
The mapped polygon (an OpenStreetMap park strip named Parklab) was not checked against the P12/P13/P15 parcel boundaries; the match is inferred.
The Rec and Park project page is undated and shows 'Project update, October 2026' alongside August 2025; the schedule on it may be revised.

The OCII November 2024 deck's timeline (slide 9) is an image with no text layer; it was read on 2026-10-12 from a rendering of the slide. It gives \"Construction (mid-2027 thru 2028)\" and \"Transfer to SF Rec Park and Park (end of 2028, upon completion)\", which differ from Rec and Park's later page (construction beginning late 2028, opening early 2030).

Parcels of the west interim uses: OCII's November 2024 update lists P12, P13 and P15 within 'Mission Bay Commons (P11, P12, P13, P15, P16, P17)'. Which interim use sits on which parcel is not stated in the sources read.

Interim uses on the west parcels: Rec and Park names Spark Social SF, Stagecoach Greens Mini Golf, Urban Sprouts Community Garden and SFF soccer fields; OCII's November 2024 legend labels the uses "SFF Soccer + Fitness Court", "Community Garden & SPARK Social SF" and "Parklab Gardens & Stagecoach Greens", so the sources do not list the same set of uses.
